entities.title: Keep the bundled schema identical to schema/ in CI
entities.summary: The package carries a copy of schema/utv-1.0.schema.json. Only the Python tests compare the two, and CI does not run them.
entities.compromise: validate_structural reads a copy of the schema, so that an installed package works without the repository. The copy is kept identical by one test, tests/test_conformance.py BundledSchema, which runs only when someone runs the Python tests.
entities.cost: A change to schema/utv-1.0.schema.json that nobody follows with the Python tests leaves validate_structural checking values against the old schema, while every other check in the repository passes. It is also the one place where a library reads a copy of shared material instead of the file at the repository root (implementations/.dev/requirements.json, shared-conformance-material).
acceptanceCriteria: A check that CI runs fails when the two files differ, or the package build copies the file from schema/ so there is nothing to keep in step.
PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests still passes from implementations/python.

origin.description: BundledSchema.test_bundled_schema_matches_repository, and the README's "a bundled copy in src/utv/data/, kept identical by a test".
